reply_text:
Ilse, I found three Quarrendon Freight Lines ticket numbers. Nothing in #north-team itself has one.

1. **QF-77031**: from #inc-qfl-sev1 (Sev 1 incident room). Dana Okafor posted it on 14 Oct 2026 as the postmortem ticket for the 4 Nov 2025 Superior dock schedule outage. It holds the webhook listener root cause.
2. **#4419**: from Moss's North cheat sheet (`teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md`, undated). Thea Ramaswell logged it for gatehouse barcode scanners failing to read trailer tags at Door 14 on third shift. It was escalated to tier-2 product support for scanner firmware testing.
3. **PD-4492**: from Moss's "Sunday prep for Ruth" digest (`teams/team-north/digests/2025-10-05-north-sunday.md`, 5 Oct 2025). Thea submitted it on 4 Oct for Pemberline Dock gatehouse kiosk alerts at the Eau Claire yard, Doors 14–18. Support patched it and the 5 Oct shift cleared without manual intervention.

The Door 14 scanner issue (#4419) and the Eau Claire kiosk alerts (PD-4492) may be related, but the sources don't say so, so I haven't linked them.

I couldn't open the account's own tickets folder. The file listing returned unrelated files, so there may be more tickets in the ticket system that this search didn't reach. The Moss digests I read are the only North notes I could find; I didn't see a separate personal notes folder for Moss.
